title: Add destination_v26: fine-tune destination_v25 for stopping at uniform walking speeds
summary: destination_v26 fine-tunes destination_v25's walking for stopping, as destination_v9 did for v8. There is no speed curriculum: every command is a walk in a uniform direction at a speed drawn uniformly from 0.05 to 0.15 m/s (walk_speed_min_mps and walk_speed_max_mps), and half of them stop after 4 to 12 s for the rest of the 20 s. The reward, the ghost_v11 inputs and the speed-scaled gait clock are destination_v25's. The native destination_v25 update-1350 checkpoint walks 8/8 at 0.075 to 0.15 m/s on the surrogate suite but fidgets after a stop at 0.05 to 0.1 m/s.
